data.name: Aneesah
data.gender_notes: Aneesah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aneesah is derived from the Arabic word 'anīs', which means 'friendly', 'intimate', or 'close companion'. The name Aneesah carries the meaning “Friend, Intimate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Aneesah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, intimate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aneesah reminds us of the importance of maintaining close relationships and treating our friends with kindness and respect.
data.etymology: Aneesah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Intimate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aneesah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أنيسة
in_arabic.meaning: أنيسة تعني الرفيقة الحميمة والصديقة الوفية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أنيسة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أنس' والذي يعني الأنس والراحة. يدل على الشخصية الودودة والمحبوبة التي تجلب الفرح لمن حولها. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف آية 30 'وَلَئِنْ لَم يَجِد فَإِنَّ رَبَّهُ لَیَجِدُ لَهَا أَكْرَمَ مِن ذلِكَ خِلَّةً وَأَنسًا'. تعتبر أنيسة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالتواصل الإنساني الحميم.

in_urdu.name: انیسہ
in_urdu.meaning: انیسہ یعنی رفیقہ محبت والا دوست
in_urdu.long_meaning: انیسہ نام عربی جڑ 'أنس' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے راحت اور انس. یہ نام انیسة کی شخصیت کی علامت ہے جو اپنے آس پاس کے لوگوں کے لیے آرام اور محبت کا ذریعہ ہوتی ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں، انیسہ ایک مقبول نام ہے جسے اکثر خوبصورت اور معنی خیز کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अनीसah
in_hindi.meaning: अनीसah मतलब दोस्त 동반ी प्रेम और स्नेह की भावना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीसah नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'أنس' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है आनंद और स्नेह. यह नाम अनीसah के चरित्र को दर्शाता है, जो अपने आसपास के लोगों के लिए सुखद और प्रिय होती है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अनीसah एक लोकप्रिय नाम है जिसे अक्सर सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण माना जाता है.

in_pashto.name: انیسې
in_pashto.meaning: انیسې معنی یې ملګرې مینه ناکه دوست
in_pashto.long_meaning: انیسې نوم د عربي ريښې 'أنس' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې د راحتۍ او مينې احساس دی. دا نوم د انیسې د شخصیت نښه ده چې د هغې شاوخوا خلکو لپاره د آرام او مینې سرچینه ده. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، انیسې د يوې پيښلي او معنوي نوم په توګه ګڼل کيږي.

in_english.name: Aneesah
in_english.meaning: Aneesah means intimate companion, friendly, and loving
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aneesah originates from the Arabic root 'أنس' (ans), meaning comfort, intimacy, and friendship. It signifies a person who is a source of joy, love, and companionship. In Islamic tradition, Aneesah is associated with positive qualities such as affection, warmth, and closeness. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Yusuf, verse 30, emphasizing the importance of finding comfort and peace in relationships.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aneesah has a significant cultural impact, as it highlights the importance of companionship and camaraderie in Islamic society. In Islamic tradition, the concept of having a sincere and trustworthy companion is deeply valued. This name could be given to a child to encourage them to be a loyal and trustworthy friend or to recognize the importance of companionship and closeness in relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aneesah holds several layers of significance. In Islamic theology, Allah is referred to as Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim or "the Most Merciful, the Compassionate." The qualities of mercy and compassion extend beyond just the divine and are encouraged to be practiced among humanity. Aneesah can be seen as a reminder to strive to foster intimate relationships with others, be it a friend or family member, as a reflection of the divine mercy and compassion we all aim to embody in our daily lives. Additionally, Aneesah's attachment to the word 'anīs' signifies that we, as individuals, can function as close companions or inspirations to others on their spiritual journeys, exemplifying the inclusiveness and love that unfairly defines Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aneesah in Arabic means "helpful, supportive, and pleasing to Allah." It is a name given to a person who is always ready to lend a helping hand and seeks Allah's pleasure in all their actions.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aneesah bint Khalid was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aneesah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aneesah was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is known for her generosity and hospitality.
